about: Highlight marks every match of a search query in a text, each in the mark component, so a reader sees why a result matched. It matches as the search filters: by substring, with letter case ignored, each term trimmed and the longer term first.

letters.about: One query with letter case ignored, the default, and matched. Ignored, it marks Net and the net in network. Matched, it marks the lower-case net alone.
letters.text: Net 30 terms apply to every invoice on the network plan.
letters.title: Letter case

looks.about: Every match takes the props of the mark, so a theme styles a match as it styles any highlight. The text look marks by weight, for a reader who does not see the fill.
looks.text: The dispute was raised on Tuesday and settled on Friday.
looks.title: Looks

search.about: Type in the field: the list keeps the titles that contain the query and marks it in each, as a help centre shows its results.
search.label: Search the help centre
search.title: Search results

terms.about: Several terms mark together, each wherever it occurs in the text.
terms.text: A refund returns a payment to the customer. A chargeback is a refund the customer's bank takes back after a dispute, and every chargeback costs a fee.
terms.title: Several terms

title: Highlight
